warnings: bank presentation: revenue = net interest income + noninterest income for every period; periods lacking either leg are blank

da: 7 derived quarter(s) (2018-06-30, 2018-09-30, 2019-06-30, 2020-09-30, 2021-06-30, 2021-09-30, 2022-06-30) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

sbc: 1 derived quarter(s) (2023-06-30) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

capex: one caption per series — 2 fiscal year(s) (2022-12-31..2023-12-31) keep the tag the earlier years used, which the filer still files, instead of a higher-priority caption that appeared later (a change of definition, not of business)

capex: the filed caption changes (2017-12-31 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment → PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets; 2024-12-31 PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets → PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment) — growth across a change is blank
implausible per-share / share-count cells blanked (more than 100× off the line's median — a filing's scale slip): shares_outstanding 2010-12-31 7.785e+05; shares_outstanding 2010-12-31 7.785e+05

Q4 EPS not derived (FY EPS − three filed quarters) where the year's quarters and the year were filed on different bases or the result's sign contradicts the Q4 net income: eps_basic 2013-12-31, eps_diluted 2013-12-31

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): selling_marketing 2009-12-31, selling_marketing 2020-12-31, other_opex 2012-12-31, other_opex 2013-12-31, other_opex 2014-12-31, net_income_continuing 2015-12-31, net_income_continuing 2018-12-31, net_income_continuing 2019-12-31, net_income_continuing 2020-12-31, discontinued_ops 2015-12-31, da 2010-12-31, da 2011-12-31...
capex: no capital-expenditure figure is filed for 39 period(s) with operating cash flow (2014-03-31..2023-09-30); free cash flow and owner's earnings are blank there (capex is never read as zero)

restricted cash: in 34 period(s), 2016-12-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 34 period(s), 2016-12-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 21 period(s) with discontinued operations (2008-12-31..2013-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there

same filing: 2 fiscal-year cell(s) of a derived figure are blank because its inputs' values come from different filing generations (one restated by a later filing, the other as originally filed) although one filing reports them all: fcf 2016-12-31, owner_earnings 2016-12-31

growth across filing generations: 30 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): book_value_per_share (2011-12-31); capex (2017-12-31, 2024-12-31); da (2021-12-31); debt_repaid (2019-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2014-12-31); intangibles (2019-12-31); net_change_cash (2018-12-31); noninterest_expense (2009-12-31, 2013-12-31); noninterest_income (2009-12-31); ocf (2016-12-31, 2021-12-31); other_lt_assets (2012-12-31, 2019-12-31); other_lt_liab (2012-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2019-12-31); ...
bank shape: interest income / expense, provision, noninterest lines, deposits and loans are shown; the non-bank interest lines are not

provision for credit losses: the filer tags no income-statement total — periods without one show the loans component + the off-balance-sheet component (both filed in that period; blank where either is absent), which can differ from the face line by other components (securities)
